# Anril AI

> Anril AI is a WhatsApp AI agent and business growth platform made in India by Bloom Matrix, serving businesses across India and overseas. It answers every enquiry on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Telegram in seconds, in Tamil, English or Tanglish, marks each lead Hot, Warm or Cold, sends bulk WhatsApp campaigns, takes payments and orders, and tracks telecaller calls, all in one platform. Plans start from ₹999 per month (plus GST). It is built for businesses that get many enquiries, in India and overseas.

## Modules
- Reach: bulk WhatsApp campaigns on the official WhatsApp API, with approved templates, contact lists and segments, scheduling, delivery and engagement reports.
- Engage: AI agent replies on WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger and Telegram, from the business's own knowledge base. Replies in Tanglish by default, any language possible, understands voice notes. Scores leads Hot, Warm or Cold, follows up, and hands over to a human.
- Commerce: payment links (Razorpay) with status, orders from enquiries, GST invoices, catalogue, stock and low-stock alerts, dispatch status.
- Telecaller software: records and scores sales calls in Tamil, English or any language, with telecaller performance measures.
- Anril Attract: a done-for-you social media and Meta/Google ads service whose leads flow into Anril's AI agent.
- Website development: static, dynamic and AI-powered websites, which can be connected to Anril.

## Key facts
- Pricing: from ₹999/month plus GST. WhatsApp message charges from Meta are separate. Overseas plans are priced in US dollars.
- Free, unlimited demos online or at the Coimbatore office. No free trial.
- Upgrade, downgrade or cancel anytime. GST invoices.
- Proof: a customer-facing business in Anril's own group has used it for 6 to 7 months and answers 1,800+ enquiries a month with it.
- Built for: schools and colleges, coaching and training institutes, study-abroad consultancies, real estate, hospitals and clinics, retail shops and boutiques, D2C brands, salons and beauty, jewellery shops, travel and tours, events and weddings, interiors and construction, gyms, hotels, car and bike dealers, restaurants, home services, loans and insurance, CA and law firms, manufacturers and B2B suppliers, and any business whose customers ask before they buy.
